title: Opportunity Bleed: Repeated Valid Signals on Held Symbols Are Being Wasted
analysis: MSFT triggered valid 2-point mean reversion signals three times on May 14 (R:R 1.68, 1.91, 1.77) and META triggered valid 4-point signals four times on May 19 (R:R 3.36, 3.16, 3.10, 3.19). Every one was rejected because the bot held an existing position in that symbol.
rationale: The no-add rule is blocking capital deployment. Over 30 days, at least 7 high-quality setups were structurally unreachable.

insight.why_now: Pattern occurred across two separate days on two symbols, confirming a structural issue.
insight.purpose: Add a Position Rotation Rule and expand the scanning universe.
insight.expected_effect: Recovers 7+ high-quality setups in a 30-day window.
insight.risks: Position rotation introduces transaction costs. Re-entry must show materially better R:R.

current_rule: 3. MAX OPEN POSITIONS: Never hold more than 5 positions simultaneously (medium_safety).
proposed_rule: 3. MAX OPEN POSITIONS: Never hold more than 5 positions simultaneously (medium_safety). POSITION ROTATION: If a valid signal fires on a symbol already held AND no alternative symbol qualifies AND the new signal R:R exceeds current R:R by >= 0.5, the bot MAY close and re-enter. WATCHLIST EXPANSION: Minimum 8 symbols across 3 sectors.

title: Sector Rotation Signal Warrants a Defensive Watchlist Tilt
analysis: Technology -2.04% and Industrials -2.81% over 5 days while Energy leads at +6.35%. VIX 18.06 elevated. SPY above 20-day MA. Watchlist concentrated in mega-cap tech — mean reversion in a downtrending sector is asymmetric.
rationale: Elevated VIX + tech sector weakness + tech-concentrated watchlist. Adding ETFs reduces single-stock tech exposure.

insight.why_now: Tech weakness is happening now; watchlist is 100% tech-adjacent.
insight.purpose: Macro-driven watchlist tilt rule based on 5-day sector performance.
insight.expected_effect: Fewer failed bounce losses in downtrending sectors.
insight.risks: Sector rotation signals can be short-lived. Lookback threshold needed.

proposed_rule:
## MACRO WATCHLIST TILT RULE
Evaluated weekly using 5-day sector performance.
- SECTOR_WEAK (< -1.5%): max 1 single-stock entry; prioritize SPY/QQQ.
- SECTOR_STRONG (> +3.0%): sector ETF eligible for scan.
- VIX 15-25: reduce position size to 1.0% risk per trade.
- VIX > 25: suspend new entries; 0.35x ATR stop on existing.
